options: Because he accepted another job offer
Because he lost his portfolio files
questions.explanation: Người phụ nữ nói: "...ask if we could reschedule his meeting to Friday morning due to a family emergency" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What will Rebecca do next?
options: Send a confirmation email to the applicant
Print copies of the applicant's resume
questions.explanation: Rebecca nói: "I'll send him a confirmation email right away..." → Chọn (A).

questions.content: Who most likely are the listeners?
options: College students touring a computer laboratory
questions.explanation: Người nói chào mừng nhân viên mới ("welcome to Crestview Technologies... leading your orientation session today") → Chọn (A).

questions.content: How long will the training program last?
questions.explanation: Người nói nêu rõ: "Over the next three days, you will receive in-depth training..." → Chọn (A).

questions.content: What are listeners instructed to do before the first module?
options: Complete an electronic emergency contact form on their tablets
Introduce themselves to the executive vice president
Take a written English comprehension examination
questions.explanation: Người nói dặn: "...please take a moment to log in to the tablets placed on your desks and complete the electronic emergency contact form" → Chọn (A).

questions.content: All job applicants must fill out the employment history form ------- prior to entering the interview room.
questions.explanation: Bổ nghĩa cho cụm động từ vị ngữ "fill out the employment history form" cần một phó từ (adverb) chỉ thể cách → chọn "completely" (một cách đầy đủ, hoàn chỉnh).

questions.content: The human resources committee expressed great ------- with the high caliber of candidate applications.
questions.explanation: Sau tính từ "great" cần danh từ làm tân ngữ trực tiếp cho động từ "expressed" → chọn "satisfaction" (sự hài lòng).

questions.content: Ms. Sterling commended the summer interns for ------- outstanding contribution to the database migration.
questions.explanation: Đứng trước cụm danh từ "outstanding contribution" cần tính từ sở hữu số nhiều tương ứng với "summer interns" → chọn "their" (của họ).

questions.content: Applicants will not be invited for an executive interview ------- their background check passes scrutiny.
questions.explanation: Theo sau là một mệnh đề hoàn chỉnh mang nghĩa điều kiện phủ định ("trừ phi việc xác minh lý lịch được thông qua") → chọn liên từ "unless" (= if not).

questions.content: The newly adopted corporate dress policy will remain in effect ------- the upcoming fiscal year.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "throughout" đi với khoảng thời gian mang nghĩa "xuyên suốt / trong toàn bộ năm tài chính sắp tới".

groups.passage:
MEMORANDUM
To: All Department Directors
From: Eleanor Vance, Human Resources Vice President
Date: September 8
Subject: Promotion Announcement

We take tremendous pride in announcing the promotion of Daniel Thorne to the position of Senior Talent Acquisition Director, effective October 1. Over the last four years, Mr. Thorne has demonstrated outstanding leadership and strategic vision in modernizing our global hiring workflows. [131] ------- his tenure, our average onboarding time decreased by thirty-five percent.

In his expanded capacity, Mr. Thorne will spearhead executive recruitment initiatives and coordinate university internship partnerships. He will be directly [132] ------- for aligning our staffing roadmap with international branch targets. [133] -------. We are confident that his analytical acumen will continue to strengthen our workforce.

Please join us in the fifth-floor reception lounge this Friday at 4:30 P.M. to celebrate his promotion. Complimentary beverages and light hors d'oeuvres will be [134] ------- by the corporate hospitality team.

questions.content: Choose the best preposition to fill in blank [131].
questions.explanation: Cụm từ chỉ khoảng thời gian nhiệm kỳ: "During his tenure" = Trong suốt nhiệm kỳ của ông ấy.

questions.content: Choose the best word to fill in blank [132].
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc cố định "be directly responsible for + V-ing/N" (chịu trách nhiệm trực tiếp cho...) → chọn tính từ "responsible".

questions.content: Choose the best sentence to fill in blank [133].
options: He will also mentor incoming recruiters across our European regional offices.
The company budget for international travel was drastically reduced.
All employees must renew their parking garage passes before Friday.
The flight to Frankfurt was delayed due to winter storms.
questions.explanation: Câu trước nói về trách nhiệm mới của Daniel Thorne. Câu (A) bổ sung thêm trách nhiệm phù hợp ("Anh ấy cũng sẽ hướng dẫn các chuyên viên tuyển dụng mới...").

questions.content: Choose the best verb form to fill in blank [134].
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc bị động tương lai: "will be + V3/ed" → chọn "provided" (sẽ được cung cấp bởi đội ngũ lễ tân).

groups.passage:
SUMMIT ENTERPRISE SOLUTIONS
Career Opportunity: Senior Cloud Systems Architect
Location: Austin, Texas (Hybrid: 3 days in office, 2 days remote)

Position Overview:
Summit Enterprise Solutions is seeking a driven Senior Cloud Systems Architect to design, optimize, and maintain our high-throughput distributed infrastructure. The successful applicant will lead cross-functional engineering teams and implement scalable microservices solutions.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
• At least 6 years of hands-on experience managing AWS or Google Cloud enterprise deployments.
• Demonstrated proficiency in infrastructure automation tools (Terraform, Ansible, Kubernetes).

Compensation & Benefits:
We offer an industry-competitive base salary ($135,000–$155,000), 100% employer-covered health and dental insurance, and a $3,000 annual professional training allowance. Qualified applicants should email a cover letter, resume, and public code repository link to careers@summitenterprise.com no later than November 15.

questions.content: What is the primary purpose of the notice?
options: To announce an open employment position
To promote an upcoming cloud computing seminar
To inform customers about scheduled server maintenance
To request bids from external software contractors
questions.explanation: Tiêu đề "Career Opportunity: Senior Cloud Systems Architect" và nội dung miêu tả công việc, yêu cầu tuyển dụng cho thấy mục đích chính là đăng tin tuyển dụng (A).

questions.content: What is NOT stated as a required qualification for the role?
options: A Master's degree in Business Administration
A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
At least 6 years managing enterprise cloud deployments
questions.explanation: Yêu cầu chỉ ghi "Bachelor's degree in Computer Science...", không hề yêu cầu bằng thạc sĩ kinh doanh (MBA) → Chọn (A).

groups.passage:
MEMORANDUM 1
To: All Engineering Staff
From: Derek Ward, VP of Product Engineering
Date: August 10
Subject: Professional Certification Reimbursement Program

To foster continuous technical innovation, Summit Enterprise will now sponsor employees pursuing industry-recognized certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect, CISSP, PMP). The company will reimburse 100% of exam registration fees and study materials up to $1,500 per calendar year.

To be eligible, employees must have completed at least six months of continuous service and receive written approval from their department head prior to purchasing courses or exam vouchers. Invoices and passing certificates must be submitted to HR within 30 days of exam completion.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

MEMORANDUM 2
To: Derek Ward, VP of Product Engineering
From: Priya Patel, Senior Systems Analyst
Date: August 12
Subject: Certification Approval Request

Dear Mr. Ward,
I am writing to formally request sponsorship under our new Professional Certification Reimbursement Program. I have been with Summit Enterprise for over two years in the cloud infrastructure unit. I intend to sit for the AWS Certified DevOps Engineer exam scheduled on October 20. The preparation course and official exam voucher cost $650 in total. My supervisor, Sandra Bullock, has already reviewed my application and endorsed my participation. Please let me know if you require any additional documentation.

Best regards,
Priya Patel

questions.content: What benefit does the new company policy introduce?
options: Financial reimbursement for approved professional certification expenses
Additional paid vacation days for employees completing training
Complimentary laptop computers for home office use
Free membership to a local athletic health club
questions.explanation: Chính sách công ty tài trợ 100% lệ phí thi và tài liệu ôn tập chứng chỉ chuyên môn lên tới $1,500/năm → Chọn (A).

questions.content: Why is Priya Patel eligible for the program?
options: She has worked at the company for more than six months
She is the head of the human resources division
She scored the highest mark on a corporate quiz
She already passed the DevOps exam in August
questions.explanation: Điều kiện chính sách là làm việc ít nhất 6 tháng; Priya Patel cho biết cô đã làm việc tại công ty hơn hai năm ("over two years") → Chọn (A).

questions.content: How much funding is Priya requesting for her certification?
questions.explanation: Priya nêu rõ: "The preparation course and official exam voucher cost $650 in total" → Chọn (A).
